card.name: Last digit of round dose numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit (usually 0, sometimes 5) of a multi-digit dose number written just before a unit such as mg or mcg/kg, as in 200, 80, 300 or 500.

modes.label: Trailing zero in dose
modes.description: The digit 0 that ends a round dose like 200, 80 or 300 right before mg.
modes.example: sertraline 20<<0>> mg/day does not produce clinically important inhibition

modes.label: Other final digit
modes.description: A final digit such as 5 in a weight-band or dose value before a unit.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a dose number, such as the 0 in 200 mg, just before the unit.
